import os, fnmatch

with open('/inputs/README.md','rb') as f:
    inp = f.read()

files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir('/inputs') if f != 'README.md' and fnmatch.fnmatch(f, '*-*.md'))
titles = {}
for f in files:
    with open(f'/inputs/{f}', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    title = None
    for line in content.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('# '):
            title = line[2:].strip()
            break
    titles[f] = title

lines = []
lines.append('')
lines.append('## Reference index')
lines.append('')
lines.append('| File | Type | Description |')
lines.append('| --- | --- | --- |')
for f in files:
    lines.append(f'| [{f}](../inputs/{f}) | .md | {titles[f]} |')

appendix = '\n'.join(lines) + '\n'
appendix_bytes = appendix.encode('utf-8')

out = inp + appendix_bytes
with open('/work/README.md','wb') as f:
    f.write(out)

print(repr(out[-600:]))
print(len(out))
